paragraphs.source_en: Takeda Shingen departed Kōfu at the head of his great army on the third day of the tenth month in the third year of Genki.

units.source_en: Takeda Shingen departed Kōfu at the head of his great army on the third day of the tenth month in the third year of Genki.
units.source_zh: 武田信玄率领大军离开甲府，是在元龟三年的十月初三。

paragraphs.source_zh: 武田信玄率领大军离开甲府，是在元龟三年的十月初三。

paragraphs.source_en: After leaving Ina in Shinano, Shingen ordered Yamagata Saburōbyōe Masakage to advance from eastern Mikawa into Tōtōmi and join the main force; on the tenth day of the tenth month, he entered Tōtōmi. Shingen advanced methodically, yet swiftly and smoothly captured Tatara and Iida, pressing on toward Kuno Castle. Meanwhile, Ieyasu led his forces to the Tenryū River. Some retainers still opposed giving battle, but he flatly rejected their objections.

units.source_en: After leaving Ina in Shinano, Shingen ordered Yamagata Saburōbyōe Masakage to advance from eastern Mikawa into Tōtōmi and join the main force; on the tenth day of the tenth month, he entered Tōtōmi.
units.source_zh: 出了信州伊奈后，信玄命令山县三郎兵卫昌景从东三河出远江，以和主力部队汇合，于十月初十进入远江。

units.source_en: Shingen advanced methodically, yet swiftly and smoothly captured Tatara and Iida, pressing on toward Kuno Castle.
units.source_zh: 信玄进军稳扎稳打，但又快速而顺利地攻下多多罗和饭田，直逼久野城。

units.source_en: Meanwhile, Ieyasu led his forces to the Tenryū River.
units.source_zh: 其间，家康率部来到天龙川。

units.source_en: Some retainers still opposed giving battle, but he flatly rejected their objections.
units.source_zh: 虽仍有家臣反对开战，但遭他断然拒绝。

paragraphs.source_zh: 出了信州伊奈后，信玄命令山县三郎兵卫昌景从东三河出远江，以和主力部队汇合，于十月初十进入远江。信玄进军稳扎稳打，但又快速而顺利地攻下多多罗和饭田，直逼久野城。其间，家康率部来到天龙川。虽仍有家臣反对开战，但遭他断然拒绝。

paragraphs.source_en: On the thirteenth day of the tenth month, Shingen received a report from his scouts in Tōtōmi, boldly advanced on Edajima, and began attacking Nakane Masateru at Futamata Castle. Meanwhile, Yamagata Saburōbyōe attacked Yoshida Castle from eastern Mikawa, swiftly occupied Idaira, and severed the route by which Oda reinforcements might come.

units.source_en: On the thirteenth day of the tenth month, Shingen received a report from his scouts in Tōtōmi, boldly advanced on Edajima, and began attacking Nakane Masateru at Futamata Castle.
units.source_zh: 十月十三，信玄接到远江探子的情报，果断逼近江台岛，开始攻打二俣城的中根正照。

units.source_en: Meanwhile, Yamagata Saburōbyōe attacked Yoshida Castle from eastern Mikawa, swiftly occupied Idaira, and severed the route by which Oda reinforcements might come.
units.source_zh: 另一面，山县三郎兵卫则从东三河方向攻打吉田城，迅速占领伊平，切断了织田方面可能派来援军的通道。

paragraphs.source_zh: 十月十三，信玄接到远江探子的情报，果断逼近江台岛，开始攻打二俣城的中根正照。另一面，山县三郎兵卫则从东三河方向攻打吉田城，迅速占领伊平，切断了织田方面可能派来援军的通道。

paragraphs.source_en: Naturally, Ieyasu sent an envoy to Gifu Castle. At the previous Battle of Anegawa, Ieyasu had voluntarily led troops into Ōmi to aid Nobunaga, and now his attempt to halt the Takeda army was likewise not solely for the benefit of the Tokugawa clan. Yet Nobunaga's reinforcements were long in coming.

units.source_en: Naturally, Ieyasu sent an envoy to Gifu Castle.
units.source_zh: 当然，家康向岐阜城派去了使者。

units.source_en: At the previous Battle of Anegawa, Ieyasu had voluntarily led troops into Ōmi to aid Nobunaga, and now his attempt to halt the Takeda army was likewise not solely for the benefit of the Tokugawa clan.
units.source_zh: 在上次姊川会战中，家康主动领兵到近江地区援助信长，就是这次阻拦武田军，也并不完全是为了德川氏的利益。

units.source_en: Yet Nobunaga's reinforcements were long in coming.
units.source_zh: 但信长的援军迟迟未到。

paragraphs.source_zh: 当然，家康向岐阜城派去了使者。在上次姊川会战中，家康主动领兵到近江地区援助信长，就是这次阻拦武田军，也并不完全是为了德川氏的利益。但信长的援军迟迟未到。

paragraphs.source_en: The tread of winter drew ever nearer, and the dark clouds of war gradually gathered over Hamamatsu Castle. Shingen had not expected Ieyasu to disregard the lives of himself and his house and meet the Takeda army in battle. “Have Akiyama Nobutomo attack Mino and subdue its defender, Oda Katsunaga. With a fire burning in his own rear, Oda Nobunaga will be unable to spare troops to support Ieyasu.”

units.source_en: The tread of winter drew ever nearer, and the dark clouds of war gradually gathered over Hamamatsu Castle.
units.source_zh: 冬日的脚步声越来越近，战争的乌云渐渐笼罩在滨松城上空。

units.source_en: Shingen had not expected Ieyasu to disregard the lives of himself and his house and meet the Takeda army in battle.
units.source_zh: 信玄没料到家康会置身家性命于不顾，迎战武田军。

units.source_en: “Have Akiyama Nobutomo attack Mino and subdue its defender, Oda Katsunaga. With a fire burning in his own rear, Oda Nobunaga will be unable to spare troops to support Ieyasu.”
units.source_zh: “让秋山信友攻打美浓，降服守将织田胜长，如此一来，后院起火的织田信长就不能分兵支援家康了。”

paragraphs.source_zh: 冬日的脚步声越来越近，战争的乌云渐渐笼罩在滨松城上空。信玄没料到家康会置身家性命于不顾，迎战武田军。“让秋山信友攻打美浓，降服守将织田胜长，如此一来，后院起火的织田信长就不能分兵支援家康了。”

paragraphs.source_en: If Ieyasu knew for certain that Oda reinforcements would never arrive, he would undoubtedly avoid battle and let the army from Kōfu pass unhindered.

units.source_en: If Ieyasu knew for certain that Oda reinforcements would never arrive, he would undoubtedly avoid battle and let the army from Kōfu pass unhindered.
units.source_zh: 如果知道织田的援兵肯定不会到来，家康无疑会回避交战，而让甲府军队顺利过去。

paragraphs.source_zh: 如果知道织田的援兵肯定不会到来，家康无疑会回避交战，而让甲府军队顺利过去。

paragraphs.source_en: In early December, three thousand reinforcements finally arrived, and the decisive battle that would determine Ieyasu's fate drew steadily nearer.

units.source_en: In early December, three thousand reinforcements finally arrived, and the decisive battle that would determine Ieyasu's fate drew steadily nearer.
units.source_zh: 十二月上旬，三千援军终于抵达，决定家康命运的决战逐渐逼近。

paragraphs.source_zh: 十二月上旬，三千援军终于抵达，决定家康命运的决战逐渐逼近。

paragraphs.source_en: Futamata Castle, the defensive strongpoint before Hamamatsu Castle, fell on December nineteenth. Its defenders were Nakane Masateru, Aoki Yoshitsugu, and Matsudaira Yasuyasu, but the Takeda army's assault was both tenacious and ingenious, and Futamata Castle could not be saved.

units.source_en: Futamata Castle, the defensive strongpoint before Hamamatsu Castle, fell on December nineteenth.
units.source_zh: 滨松城的正面据守之点二俣城于十二月十九陷落。

units.source_en: Its defenders were Nakane Masateru, Aoki Yoshitsugu, and Matsudaira Yasuyasu, but the Takeda army's assault was both tenacious and ingenious, and Futamata Castle could not be saved.

ja.t: ちこたえられなかった。

units.source_zh: 守将乃中根正照、青木吉继、松平康安，但武田军的进攻十分顽强而巧妙，二俣城最终不保。

paragraphs.source_zh: 滨松城的正面据守之点二俣城于十二月十九陷落。守将乃中根正照、青木吉继、松平康安，但武田军的进攻十分顽强而巧妙，二俣城最终不保。

paragraphs.source_en: The Takeda commanders charged with taking Futamata Castle were men of the main family, including Takeda Katsuyori, Takeda Nobutoyo, and Anayama Baisetsu. Shingen himself sometimes came to order fierce assaults, but they ultimately failed. At last, they adopted the advice of Yamagata and Baba and changed to a strategy of cutting off the water supply.

units.source_en: The Takeda commanders charged with taking Futamata Castle were men of the main family, including Takeda Katsuyori, Takeda Nobutoyo, and Anayama Baisetsu. Shingen himself sometimes came to order fierce assaults, but they ultimately failed.
units.source_zh: 武田家负责攻打二俣城的是武田胜赖、武田信丰、穴山梅雪等嫡系将领，信玄也不时前来命令强攻，但终于失败。

units.source_en: At last, they adopted the advice of Yamagata and Baba and changed to a strategy of cutting off the water supply.
units.source_zh: 最后采取山县和马场的建议，改用断绝水源之法。

paragraphs.source_zh: 武田家负责攻打二俣城的是武田胜赖、武田信丰、穴山梅雪等嫡系将领，信玄也不时前来命令强攻，但终于失败。最后采取山县和马场的建议，改用断绝水源之法。

paragraphs.source_en: Futamata Castle had built a tall water tower over the Tenryū River flowing west of the castle and drew water from it with a pulley, much as one drew water from a well. The Takeda side released many rafts upstream, covering the water's surface and preventing the pulley from drawing water properly. Once the water supply was cut, even the bravest soldiers could fight no longer.

units.source_en: Futamata Castle had built a tall water tower over the Tenryū River flowing west of the castle and drew water from it with a pulley, much as one drew water from a well.
units.source_zh: 二俣城在流经城西的天龙川上修建了高大的水库，利用滑车从中取水，就像从水井中取水一般。

units.source_en: The Takeda side released many rafts upstream, covering the water's surface and preventing the pulley from drawing water properly.
units.source_zh: 武田方则在上游放了许多木筏，布满水面，使得水滑车无法顺利取水。

units.source_en: Once the water supply was cut, even the bravest soldiers could fight no longer.
units.source_zh: 水源一断，再勇猛的士兵也无法继续战斗。

paragraphs.source_zh: 二俣城在流经城西的天龙川上修建了高大的水库，利用滑车从中取水，就像从水井中取水一般。武田方则在上游放了许多木筏，布满水面，使得水滑车无法顺利取水。水源一断，再勇猛的士兵也无法继续战斗。

paragraphs.source_en: To prevent the castle from falling, Ieyasu personally led twenty-five hundred troops to its relief and advanced as far as Kanzō Village, but upon learning that the castle had already fallen, he immediately withdrew to Hamamatsu Castle.

units.source_en: To prevent the castle from falling, Ieyasu personally led twenty-five hundred troops to its relief and advanced as far as Kanzō Village, but upon learning that the castle had already fallen, he immediately withdrew to Hamamatsu Castle.
units.source_zh: 为了不让此城陷落，家康亲自率领两千五百兵马前来增援，一直前进到了神增村，但得知该城已经陷落，便马上撤回了滨松城。

paragraphs.source_zh: 为了不让此城陷落，家康亲自率领两千五百兵马前来增援，一直前进到了神增村，但得知该城已经陷落，便马上撤回了滨松城。

paragraphs.source_en: Hamamatsu Castle now stood completely exposed before the enemy.

units.source_en: Hamamatsu Castle now stood completely exposed before the enemy.
units.source_zh: 滨松城已完全暴露在敌人面前。

paragraphs.source_zh: 滨松城已完全暴露在敌人面前。

paragraphs.source_en: According to intelligence received that morning, Shingen still appeared to have no intention of fighting a decisive battle with Ieyasu. Perhaps the rumors that Nobunaga's reinforcements were arriving one after another had exerted some influence; Shingen was said to have crossed the Osakabe-Nakagawa River and Iinoya and to be advancing toward eastern Mikawa.

units.source_en: According to intelligence received that morning, Shingen still appeared to have no intention of fighting a decisive battle with Ieyasu.
units.source_zh: 据这天早晨得到的情报，信玄好像还是没有和家康决战之意。

units.source_en: Perhaps the rumors that Nobunaga's reinforcements were arriving one after another had exerted some influence; Shingen was said to have crossed the Osakabe-Nakagawa River and Iinoya and to be advancing toward eastern Mikawa.
units.source_zh: 或许是因为信长援军不断到来的传言，在某种程度上起了作用，据说信玄已经越过刑部中川和井伊谷，向东三河而来。

paragraphs.source_zh: 据这天早晨得到的情报，信玄好像还是没有和家康决战之意。或许是因为信长援军不断到来的传言，在某种程度上起了作用，据说信玄已经越过刑部中川和井伊谷，向东三河而来。

paragraphs.source_en: “Nine Oda contingents have already reached Hamamatsu, and I hear that many Oda troops are also active around Shirahazama near Okazaki. Even if we take Hamamatsu Castle, Nobunaga's reinforcements will attack when we are exhausted. Rather than risk that, we should bypass Ieyasu and advance directly.” If Shingen had made his view so clear, was there any need for Ieyasu to set himself against them?

units.source_en: “Nine Oda contingents have already reached Hamamatsu, and I hear that many Oda troops are also active around Shirahazama near Okazaki.
units.source_zh: “织田的援军已经有九支抵达滨松，而且听说冈崎白须间一带还有不少织田军在活动。

units.source_en: Even if we take Hamamatsu Castle, Nobunaga's reinforcements will attack when we are exhausted.
units.source_zh: 即使攻下滨松城，信长的援军也会趁我们疲惫之际发动进攻。

units.source_en: Rather than risk that, we should bypass Ieyasu and advance directly.”
units.source_zh: 与其那样，还不如避开家康而直接前进。”

units.source_en: If Shingen had made his view so clear, was there any need for Ieyasu to set himself against them?
units.source_zh: 信玄如此表明看法，那么家康还有必要和他们过不去吗？

paragraphs.source_zh: “织田的援军已经有九支抵达滨松，而且听说冈崎白须间一带还有不少织田军在活动。即使攻下滨松城，信长的援军也会趁我们疲惫之际发动进攻。与其那样，还不如避开家康而直接前进。”信玄如此表明看法，那么家康还有必要和他们过不去吗？

paragraphs.source_en: Mikatagahara lay north of Hamamatsu Castle. North of Futamata Castle stretched Saigagake, and Mikatagahara lay atop it—a desolate, scrub-covered tract twenty-four ri long and sixteen ri wide. Ieyasu intended to stake everything on a decisive battle there. Under Ieyasu's piercing gaze, Sakai Saemon-no-jō Tadatsugu could not help averting his eyes.

units.source_en: Mikatagahara lay north of Hamamatsu Castle.
units.source_zh: 三方原在滨松城以北。

units.source_en: North of Futamata Castle stretched Saigagake, and Mikatagahara lay atop it—a desolate, scrub-covered tract twenty-four ri long and sixteen ri wide.
units.source_zh: 二俣城向北紧连着犀崖，三方原就位于犀崖之上，其纵长二十四里，横宽十六里，是一块灌木丛生的荒芜之地。

units.source_en: Ieyasu intended to stake everything on a decisive battle there.
units.source_zh: 家康要在此决一死战。

units.source_en: Under Ieyasu's piercing gaze, Sakai Saemon-no-jō Tadatsugu could not help averting his eyes.
units.source_zh: 在家康锐利目光的注视之下，酒井左卫门尉忠次不禁避开视线。

paragraphs.source_zh: 三方原在滨松城以北。二俣城向北紧连着犀崖，三方原就位于犀崖之上，其纵长二十四里，横宽十六里，是一块灌木丛生的荒芜之地。家康要在此决一死战。在家康锐利目光的注视之下，酒井左卫门尉忠次不禁避开视线。

paragraphs.source_en: “Tadatsugu, you will command the right wing!”

units.source_en: “Tadatsugu, you will command the right wing!”
units.source_zh: “忠次，令你为右翼！”

paragraphs.source_zh: “忠次，令你为右翼！”

paragraphs.source_en: Tadatsugu acknowledged the order. If he had merely been assigned the right wing, he indeed had neither grounds to object nor any opportunity to state his opinion. Until the entire formation had been arranged, he could not speak rashly.

units.source_en: Tadatsugu acknowledged the order.
units.source_zh: 忠次应了一声。

units.source_en: If he had merely been assigned the right wing, he indeed had neither grounds to object nor any opportunity to state his opinion.

ja.t: されたというだけなら、たしかに

units.source_zh: 倘若只被任命为右翼，那他的确既没有反对的理由，也无法表述意见。

units.source_en: Until the entire formation had been arranged, he could not speak rashly.
units.source_zh: 在布阵全部结束以前，他不能轻易开口。

paragraphs.source_zh: 忠次应了一声。倘若只被任命为右翼，那他的确既没有反对的理由，也无法表述意见。在布阵全部结束以前，他不能轻易开口。

paragraphs.source_en: “Kazumasa, you will command the left wing!”

units.source_en: “Kazumasa, you will command the left wing!”
units.source_zh: “数正，你为左翼！”

paragraphs.source_zh: “数正，你为左翼！”

paragraphs.source_en: “Understood!” Ishikawa Kazumasa held his face rigid and bit hard upon his lip as though angry.

units.source_en: “Understood!”
units.source_zh: “明白！”

units.source_en: Ishikawa Kazumasa held his face rigid and bit hard upon his lip as though angry.
units.source_zh: 石川数正紧紧地绷着脸，好像生气似的紧咬嘴唇。

paragraphs.source_zh: “明白！”石川数正紧紧地绷着脸，好像生气似的紧咬嘴唇。

paragraphs.source_en: “Next comes the disposition of the main force. Takigawa Kazumasu will stand to Tadatsugu's left, Hirate to Takigawa Kazumasu's left, and Sakuma and the other three Oda commanders to Hirate's left.”

units.source_en: “Next comes the disposition of the main force.
units.source_zh: “接下来，是主力的安排。

units.source_en: Takigawa Kazumasu will stand to Tadatsugu's left, Hirate to Takigawa Kazumasu's left, and Sakuma and the other three Oda commanders to Hirate's left.”
units.source_zh: 泷川一益在忠次之左，平手在泷川一益之左，佐久间和织田方的三位将军在平手左边。”

paragraphs.source_zh: “接下来，是主力的安排。泷川一益在忠次之左，平手在泷川一益之左，佐久间和织田方的三位将军在平手左边。”

paragraphs.source_en: “Understood.” The three Oda commanders, who had already witnessed the fierce mettle of the Mikawa men in Ōmi, knew this was no place for them to interject.

units.source_en: “Understood.”
units.source_zh: “明白。”

units.source_en: The three Oda commanders, who had already witnessed the fierce mettle of the Mikawa men in Ōmi, knew this was no place for them to interject.
units.source_zh: 已在近江地区见识三河人威猛之风的织田方三位武将，知道这里不是可以插嘴的地方。

paragraphs.source_zh: “明白。”已在近江地区见识三河人威猛之风的织田方三位武将，知道这里不是可以插嘴的地方。

paragraphs.source_en: “Heihachi will defend the position to Kazumasa's left.”

units.source_en: “Heihachi will defend the position to Kazumasa's left.”
units.source_zh: “数正之左，由平八去防守。”

paragraphs.source_zh: “数正之左，由平八去防守。”

paragraphs.source_en: Honda Heihachirō Tadakatsu broke into a smile and nodded.

units.source_en: Honda Heihachirō Tadakatsu broke into a smile and nodded.
units.source_zh: 本多平八郎忠胜展颜一笑，点了点头。

paragraphs.source_zh: 本多平八郎忠胜展颜一笑，点了点头。

paragraphs.source_en: “Ietada will stand to Heihachi's right.”

units.source_en: “Ietada will stand to Heihachi's right.”
units.source_zh: “平八右侧是家忠。”

paragraphs.source_zh: “平八右侧是家忠。”

paragraphs.source_en: Ieyasu's tone was so stern that Matsudaira Ietada could offer no objection. He glanced at Heihachirō and answered readily, “Yes!”

units.source_en: Ieyasu's tone was so stern that Matsudaira Ietada could offer no objection. He glanced at Heihachirō and answered readily, “Yes!”
units.source_zh: 家康命令的语气如此严厉，松平家忠根本无法反驳，他瞥了一眼平八郎，痛快地答道：“是！”

paragraphs.source_zh: 家康命令的语气如此严厉，松平家忠根本无法反驳，他瞥了一眼平八郎，痛快地答道：“是！”

paragraphs.source_en: “Yes. There are cliffs before and behind us, to the left and right, and no avenue of retreat.”

units.source_en: “Yes.
There are cliffs before and behind us, to the left and right, and no avenue of retreat.”

ja.t: はまったくありません」

units.source_zh: 前后左右都是悬崖，没有任何退路。”

paragraphs.source_zh: “是。前后左右都是悬崖，没有任何退路。”

paragraphs.source_en: “If you all understand, withdraw at once and make your preparations separately. One more thing—Hanzō.”

units.source_en: “If you all understand, withdraw at once and make your preparations separately.
units.source_zh: “如果都明白了，就立刻退下，分头准备。

units.source_en: One more thing—Hanzō.”
